text:
nightly-bot: :warning: Overnight eval 4681234567 — two failing suites for model rwd-v2-int8 on quant-small pools. shortseq_cohort: 6/50 blank responses (baseline ~0.4%). structout_json: 4/50 malformed/truncated JSON. full stats in CI logs.

Anya: ack, I'll take initial triage. which infra pool and quant build?

nightly-bot: infra=quant-small-us-west, quant-build=2026-03-19-2, seed sweep ran 42..47

Ben: saw something similar locally on staging-int8. quick repro with batch_size=2 produced blanks on very short prompts.

Carlos: possible qkernel regression after fused-attn refactor in 0a1b..9f2c. int8 path touched the serializer for KV cache.

Mia: I'll replay the exact failing IDs from the suite with seed 42 and beam=1. will try batch_size 1/2/4.

Evan: severity P2 — not platform-down but user-visible. Owners: @Anya (triage lead), @Carlos (runtime/quant kernel), @Mia (eval replay). Ping if you need dedicated infra or rollback.

Anya: repro command I'm running now:
```
python tools/run_eval.py --model rwd-v2-int8 --suite shortseq_cohort --ids 101-160 --seed 42 --batch-size 2 --kvcache false
```
Seeing blank when prefix_len <= 8, looks deterministic for those prompts.

Ben: confirmed: batch_size=1 -> 0/50 blank, batch_size=2 -> matches nightly 6/50. suspect batching interaction with kv cache disabled path.

Carlos: digging into quant kernel diff, there's a conditional in attention_kernel that skips K/V copy when small_prefix optimization enabled. might skip zeroing a buffer on batch>1.

Mia: CI replay started. first pass: batch_size=1 -> 0/50, batch_size=2 -> 5/50 blank, structout_json parse_error still at same indices.

Anya: notes — structured JSON failures look like truncation mid-object, not hallucinated tokens. points to tokenization/streaming or early termination in decode loop.

Carlos: will run bisect on quant runtime commits between 0a1b..9f2c, focusing on attention and kvcache code. ETA ~2h unless I get a quick local repro.

Ben: short-term mitigation: route traffic for affected suite to rwd-v2-fp16 or fallback to hosted fp16 until kernel fix. update routing policy?

Evan: agreed. I'll open a debit ticket to route eval traffic and add a temporary canary for CI. Set follow-up meeting tomorrow 10:30 PT.

Mia: CI replay mid-run: increased beam to 4 to check truncation—truncation persists with beam>1. attaching truncated parse snippet:
```
{"id": 12345, "answer": "The result is "
# EOF
```

Anya: good notes. I'll create an internal bug with failing example payloads and mark as P2-blocker for onboarding until verified. I'll post repro artifacts in the ticket.

Carlos: quick update — I isolated the memcpy path that conditionally runs for batch>1. patch candidate ready to test: will push to dev-quant and ask Mia to re-run failing IDs.

Mia: re-run on dev-quant patch: batch_size=2 -> 0/50 blank, structout_json parse errors -> 0/50. Looks promising. pushing full CI replay now.

Evan: excellent. keep rollback plan ready; if CI green, we can promote patch and remove routing mitigation. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Mia: CI full replay passed on dev-quant patch. logging the green run id: ci-4681234590. will follow up with logs and attach to bug.

nightly-bot: noted fix candidate deployed to dev-quant, awaiting promotion.
